kaggle-wur.name: World University Rankings (Kaggle: mylesoneill/world-university-rankings), THE 2011–2016, CWUR 2012–2015, ARWU 2005–2015
kaggle-wur.note: Used as a roster only; its ranks are not kept. Licence: Data files © Original Authors.

notes: Kaggle names are matched to QS 2027 by exact normalised name, or by a same-country token subset with at most two extra tokens. Unmatched Kaggle names stay as separate records without a QS rank; some are spelling variants of a QS institution and are listed in unmatchedKaggle for review.

tier 1 = Kaplan partner, located in Singapore, the United Kingdom, Australia or Ireland, or in the QS 2027 top 500: programme-level data is collected for these, in phases (English-speaking countries and Hong Kong first). tier 2 = institution record only for now.
